personal_information.title: Data-driven Customer Experience, Analytics & Digital Growth Specialist
personal_information.summary: As a data-driven Customer Experience specialist, I transform complex user behavior and digital interaction data into actionable insights. I specialize in mapping end-to-end customer journeys, identifying friction points through analytics, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive meaningful improvements. By leveraging data, experimentation and UX best practices, I consistently enhance conversion rates, customer satisfaction and long-term brand loyalty.
